findings.note: Workspace.rule_problem enforces the promotion rules per operation: a delta file may ADD only a fresh candidate (trust observed or external, note provenance, no votes, outside owner/), and EDIT_TEXT, MOVE_SCOPE, SET_STATUS, LINK, UNLINK, SUPERSEDE, RESTORE and INC_HARMFUL refuse owner-stated, standing and owner/ items. Owner-level ops carry an owner proof and are accepted only in a delta built in this process (trusted_delta) or in verify's replay; learn apply refuses any op with an owner key. verify fails, locked or not, when a recorded delta breaks the rules, and prints how many owner-level changes it replayed. Not done: verify does not re-derive a delta from the inbox (proposal 2: fragile, would give false alarms), so a delta file can still vote for and promote a non-owner lesson and a forged history with a well-shaped owner proof replays; the hook and CI parts (proposals 3 and 4) are package E.

build_decay fades only learned lessons (provenance note:*, trust observed, type rule or pitfall); seed, derived, owner/, playbooks/ and owner-stated items are never touched; an overdue fact is reported as stale. Retirement counts 180 days from demoted_on, not from last use. New RESTORE op and brain learn restore <id> --reason (learned lesson returns on probation, shipped knowledge as it was, owner items need --quote). On a copy of the real memory, decay one year ahead leaves 141 active. A used record with followed false and shown true now refreshes last_used; writing such records is package E.

learn note prints the id the note will get and up to two nearest existing items (candidates included); --confirms <id> records a confirmation in other words (re-noting the same text replaces the earlier pending note). A candidate is credited from a used record only when shown is true; learn.replace_session_records sets shown from the project's recall log (learn.shown_ids). A never-shown candidate is not demoted before 180 days. The rehearsal has a second session that confirms the lesson and reaches probation. The recall trial slot is package M.

A project-scoped note is written on probation (active when the owner's quote was verified), always with trust observed so it fits package M's cap on project files. Votes for ids that live in the project's .brain/memory are applied there by learn.project_votes (called from replace_session_records): once per session, only when shown, probation to active on two supporting sessions, and never sent to the brain inbox.

Demotions per run are capped at max(1, a tenth of the file's live items), least retained first, and the output says how many wait. Revival: a helpful vote or a new note of the same lesson brings a demoted lesson back on probation (not one the owner corrected or withdrew).

An external fact that restates a live fact with different numbers, number words or identifiers (or opposite polarity) is added and SUPERSEDEs it, starting on probation so recall shows the new text; with the same keys it emits the new REVERIFY op (verified_on moves, no votes). brain learn reverify <id> --source <https> does the same by command. Platform and ecosystem file names (CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, settings.json, package.json and others) no longer make a lesson project-specific. Consolidation prints up to five official leads and names the inbox file for the rest.

_shape_problem rejects a malformed record with file and line before anything touches it, each record is handled inside a guard, and a rejected record counts as processed so its file is marked. A record whose id was already seen in the batch, already folded (stats/ml.json seen list) or already in the month's ledger file is skipped; a note from a session that already supports the item gives no second vote. learning/digest/ is outside the replay comparison. Not done: the doctor dry-run line (engine/doctor.py, package B).

A lesson that does not fit a full file is rejected alone with the next step (run: brain learn decay) and the rest of the delta applies; only items in use (not demoted) count against the 400 budget; an item keeps its first 8 evidence entries and the 20 newest session:/outcome: entries. The analyst's 'retire demoted first near the budget' was not needed once demoted items stopped counting.

build_note runs the actionable test, so a refusal is immediate and one line. actionable is looser: any clause that opens with a verb or states a norm passes, with Spanish cues; clauses that open with a pronoun or auxiliary, or a noun phrase tied to a copula or past tense, do not. All 123 non-fact items of the real memory pass (32 failed before); eight sample observations are refused.
A pitfall needs an outcome of the note's own session whose gate_runs show a red run then a green run of the same gate; the two-session pairing by class is gone.

Polarity is read from the main clause ('stop and ask' is positive, a reason after 'because' does not flip it). New UNLINK op; a conflict with a demoted, retired or superseded item no longer blocks, and status counts only live conflicts. brain learn confirm <keep> --quote settles a conflict (the other side is demoted and unlinked). INC_HARMFUL on an owner item is refused and consolidation never emits one. The items.confidence change is package M.

Facts and owner items take no votes from outcomes (the use is recorded, marked failed for the digest). Demotion from outcomes applies only to learned lessons and needs 8 followed uses, harm in 3 different weeks and a harm share whose lower bound is above one half; a correction whose quote re-verifies demotes at once. Shipped items followed in failed sessions are listed in the digest as 'In question'. Not done from the proposal: skipping votes inside an open drift alarm or when the red gate turned green on the same commit.
